revisionTitle: F2 · Book Detail · Final Crosswalk Pilot

deltas.oldValue: Phone and Tablet masters contained flat/manual Hero, Summary, Chapter, ActionBar and QuickSourceSheet structures.
deltas.newValue: Both masters preserve the approved resting layout while inheriting attached Hero, Summary, ChapterSection, ChapterRow, ActionBar and QuickSourceSheet components.

deltas.oldValue: Chapter rows had no canonical state matrix and no reusable chapter-label property.
deltas.newValue: Phone and Tablet provide Default, Pressed, Focus, Disabled, Loading and Selected variants with a real ChapterLabel text property and 44px interaction intent.

deltas.oldValue: Delete, busy, failed, offline and retry states were only local runtime contracts without Book Detail Figma evidence.
deltas.newValue: DeleteDialog reuses Overlay/Dialog for Default, Loading and Failed; RetryStatus reuses State/StatusPanel for Loading, Error and Offline without changing local ownership.

deltas.oldValue: Seven conditional local actions had stable identities but no truthful Figma node targets.
deltas.newValue: Seven intents each expose Default, Pressed, Focus, Disabled, Loading and Selected variants; all use the existing status-action visual source and 44px hit-target height.

deltas.oldValue: Reader Full Directory displayed chapters 30–33 only, while local book-directory also declared stable identities for chapters 34–36.
deltas.newValue: Reader Full Directory remains untouched downstream evidence; three attached ChapterRow instances provide exact chapter 34–36 crosswalk targets without creating another route owner.

deltas.oldValue: Responsive layout existed but internal structures did not inherit the new Book Detail canonical component graph.
deltas.newValue: Phone 390×844 and Tablet 760×960 each contain 9 attached instances; landscape aliases Tablet; no Compact/Fold master or detached instance exists.

stateCoverage.localOwnerBoundary: Figma does not alter UiEvent, reducer ownership, asynchronous guards, route ownership, focus ownership, or business flow.
